svg.title: NEURON workflow
svg.desc: The default full-sample workflow processes an aligned nanopore BAM into CNS tumour classification, MGMT promoter methylation, copy-number calls and tumour cell fraction. The optional retrospective time course uses barcode-matched sequencing-summary reads at cumulative time points to reconstruct Sturgeon scores and copy-number profiles.
svg.text: Snakemake + Apptainer • Local Linux or SLURM
Output shared by ACE and CGHcall
Both models reuse the same BED
Cutoffs come from timecourse.bins in config/samples.yaml. The current report requests classifier and copy-number results at every cutoff.
